semiconductor_relevance: Medium — YuanHe Mechanical Technology specializes in vacuum components essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: YuanHe Mechanical Technology Co., Ltd. manufactures high-quality stainless steel vacuum components, including flanges, fittings, valves, and custom chambers tailored for ultra-high vacuum applications. Their products are crucial for maintaining the integrity and performance of vacuum systems in semiconductor fabrication.

Custom vacuum piping and chamber solutions
